meta.title: Typing the full name of a user who cannot see the PR still shows nothing

plan.title: PR assignee search respects team visibility

steps.note: Enable the required PR team-filtering configuration for this case.
Stay on the Open tab where PR-2 is available.

args.goal: Find PR-2 (ENGG STORE), select one of its line items, click the Assign person button next to Upload PRs, verify the Search a user box opens, search for the full name of User A (Food Buyer) and verify no result is shown, then search using part of User A's email and verify no result is shown; stop on the empty assignee search results.

steps.note: Perform the assignee search and verify that team filtering cannot be bypassed by a full-name or partial-email query.
Confirm the assignee search interface remains present after the no-result checks.
